properties.description: Three test files, the first two written first and observed failing on main (b19b49d): crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_fields_own_terms_have_one_home.rs (the reviewed mathematics table, one term one home within a field, every term says what it means, served on its type, no term spelled as a type's name, declared fields only, the lookup by case and spacing, and what was judged out stays out) and crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_field_term_finds_the_type_that_holds_it.rs (describe_schema's lookup by a field's word for node and edge types, a type's own name answering as before, also_called on every type's answer, find_tools over the corpus's mathematical phrasings, and the requirement's SHOWN WHEN sentence through both tools). Plus unit tests in crates/reflow2-core/src/vocabulary.rs (the terms add a key and change nothing else, over the whole listing, every type and all 784 pairs) and crates/reflow2-mcp/src/field_terms.rs (the index, phrase matching, and no corpus query gaining anything).
properties.findings:
On branch feat/the-vocabulary-is-served-in-a-fields-own-terms at 4fcdcdea4 (main e45225520 merged in), warm worktree under the shared build lock. FIRST, on main b19b49d: core 0 of 6 passed (every rule refused an empty table); MCP 5 of 7 failed (describe_schema refused "Unknown node type: lemma" and "counterexample"; no type carried also_called; no mathematical phrasing ranked its tool first; the SHOWN WHEN sentence ranked claim_region, add_contributor, authored_by); the 2 that passed are the guards. NOW: core 8/8, MCP 7/7, unit tests pass; cargo test --workspace 3,376 passed 0 failed (4 ignored, unchanged); core on the in-memory backend 2,129 passed; clippy both configurations clean with -D warnings. Live binary: 25 of 25 mathematical phrasings put every named tool in the top 5 and one of them first (main: 1 of 15 in the top 5, none first); the replica agrees with find_tools at top 1 on 221/221. Additive, measured on the phase-1 head against main b19b49d over 1,037 replies (tools/list, describe_schema whole, every type, required-only, all 784 pairs, find_tools for 195 corpus queries): 1,032 identical apart from also_called; 5 already over budget differ only in their budget block's counts. tools/list: only find_tools' description changes, by the clause saying it searches a field's words (toolsnap.py: 1 changed of 198). Not checked here: whether a term is apt for a reader other than the reviewer; plurals ("lemmas") are not matched.

RE-RUN 2026-10-15 at 12e25deac, after bare "induction" became "proof by induction" and "mathematical induction": core term tests 8/8, MCP term tests 8/8 (a new one holds three guards: add_inference does not rank first for "size the induction motor" (live first: granularity_report), "induction heating coil" (no tool matched) or "add an induction loop detector" (add_flow)), every_tool_is_found 5/5, find_tools_ranks 2/2, field_terms unit 3/3; clippy both configurations clean. 26 of 26 mathematical phrasings pass; the SHOWN WHEN sentence's top three are add_inference ("follows from"), add_requirement ("lemma"), add_constraint ("hypothesis"); the replica agrees with find_tools at top 1 on 225/225.
